evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 6 semesters
Corvinus offers affordable tuition fees for self-funded degree seeking international students

notes: The tuition figure (EUR 7,000/year) is quoted from the Corvinus Fees and Costs page, which lists 'non-EEA applicants (EUR/year)'; the Studyfinder page does not state a fee. No application deadline for non-EU applicants is given with a day, month and year on the supplied pages, so the 'intakes' fact is omitted; the application-information page gives general 2027/28 opening (October 2026) and a 1 August document submission date, but these are not stated as the non-EU application deadline. The mathematics requirement is a manual check because the pages give many accepted qualifications and a points threshold set by the Dean.

evidence.quote: Corvinus accepts the following proof of English language proficiency (minimum equivalent B2 level)

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée écrit de mathématiques en ligne est obligatoire ; vous pouvez aussi présenter une qualification acceptée (AP, SAT, ACT, IB, A-level, etc.).
note.en: An online written mathematics entrance exam is required; you can also present an accepted qualification (AP, SAT, ACT, IB, A-level, etc.).

evidence.quote: If you do not or will not have any of these qualifications by the time of enrolment, you can take the Corvinus mathematics entrance exam instead.
